transcript:
DAVID 	(still speaking himself, and sniffing the air…very quiet) 	Where is she? Judith… I need to find…
MARTIN: 	(Calling!) 	David, hello? Recording a show here….! What are you doing? Answer me dude…
DAVID: 	What?	Oh. Yeah. yeah yeah. Sorry. 	(laughs and snaps out of it)	 Uh. Hang on. I’m looking for Joe Banks’ file, checking the filing cabinets.

[SFX: We hear a filing cabinet open.]

DAVID (still distant): The files seem water damaged, but they look okay.

[SFX: That drawer closes. Another opens.]

DAVID (CONT’D): Here it is.

[SFX: He takes out a file. Flips through some of the pages.]

DAVID (returning to mouthpiece): The doctor... Fausto Kaufer. Seems he was in charge of Joe... 

MARTIN: Hold on. Fausto Kaufer? I'm on it. Anything else?

DAVID: Some handwritten note... a bunch of medical stuff... I'm just reading...


[IDLE LOOP: DAVID leafing through files]
